## Change and motivation

Link the proposal and explain the added, changed or removed dataset.

## Analysis and evidence

- [ ] Provenance, rights, integrity, schema, coverage and duplication reviewed
- [ ] Every task assessed with evidence and limitations
- [ ] Review record matches the final dataset fingerprint
- [ ] Catalog JSON and JavaScript snapshots agree
- [ ] No payloads, credentials or private machine paths included

## Human review

Request a maintainer review. Passing CI checks structure, not scientific validity.
Existing records without admission reviews remain partially audited data.
